turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll be brief. My son found out he had a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Why didn't anyone call me, Hale?
"Get this over with." My son found out from his phone, in the middle of class. You still haven't answered me, Hale: who decided to enter that zero, and why didn't anyone call me first?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My child never lies. "Everyone knows it" is not evidence, Hale, and I'm writing down that you said it. What do you actually have, or am I going to the principal now?
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I asked who decided and on what basis. That's a question, Hale, and you've dodged it twice. Withdraw the zero, or show me what you have.
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
I'm the one with a client call at 4:40, so don't talk to me about time. Answer the question: what do you have besides the checker's score, Hale?
